consent.title: Share my location
consent.question: Do you agree to share your location with the participants?
consent.description: Your location will be visible in real time to the other participants during the session. It is deleted as soon as you leave the session and is never stored.
consent.note: You can stop sharing at any time.

accessibility.liveMapLabel: Live map with {{participantCount}} participants. Open the list view to read the details as text.
accessibility.viewLiveListHint: Shows live participants as a text list

errors.not_configured: Real-time is not available yet. Please try again later.
errors.network: Connection lost. Check your internet connection.
errors.permission_denied: Access to the real-time service was denied.
errors.permission_blocked: Location is blocked. Enable it in settings.
errors.timeout: Could not get your location in time.
